_meta.purpose: D5.4 damage/needs fixture. Each row is fed through the REAL makeDamageAssessmentEntry factory (src/domain/damage-assessment.ts), whose `report` slice is a Pick of the UNCHANGED PublicReport pipeline — so a triage state that the pipeline cannot produce cannot appear in this fixture either.
_meta.clock: fixed — no timestamps are needed by the assessment (it is clock-free); the report slice carries only id/status/incidentId
_meta.coverage: all four triage states (UNVERIFIED, TRIAGED, VERIFIED, REJECTED), all three categories, several severities and need kinds — so the buckets that must never be summed are all non-empty
_meta.privacy: Art. XIV — the rows carry report ids and site counts. No reporter, no name, no contact, no casualty.
